column4: The fair value calculation assumed that when the allocation between the Class A-2 Notes is determined on or before the date of pricing, the maximum amount of Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $329,150,000 (in which case, $0 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued) and the minimum amount of the Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $82,290,000 (in which case $246,860,000 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued).
